summary.name: Boop
summary.one_liner: Boop is a free, open source scriptable scratchpad for pasting plain text and transforming it with built-in or custom JavaScript actions.
use_cases: format or minify JSON without pasting into an online tool
generate MD5 or other hashes of text
count characters or transform escaped strings
run custom JavaScript actions on pasted text
summary.what_it_does: Boop is a scratchpad where you paste plain text and transform it using actions. It comes preloaded with a set of built-in actions for common developer tasks. You can add your own scripts, written in JavaScript, which receive the text as state.fullText and modify it. The page includes an example script, the Poopificator, which replaces random words with poop emoji, and notes that it must be imported manually. The page describes the app as free and open source.
notable: Custom scripts in JavaScript with a simple api/main(state) structure
Preloaded with many built-in text actions
Runs locally rather than sending pasted text to websites
caveats: The page does not name any platform explicitly beyond implying macOS (Swift, Xcode, ⌘+N references); no other platforms are stated
The Poopificator script must be imported manually
